identity.intro: I build across applied AI and the web, from browser instruments to full-stack applications. I like understanding how the data, application logic, and interface fit together.

projects.name: UNHEARD
projects.brief: Draw a gesture. Hear an instrument.
projects.detail: A browser studio mapping movement to pitch, timing and stereo position. Six synthesized presets. Compositions saved locally.

projects.name: Recruitment Portal
projects.brief: Applications with rules enforced on the server.
projects.detail: Extended an existing portal with student applications and coordinator review. Firestore transactions enforce limits and prevent duplicates.

projects.name: Drone Mapper
projects.brief: A quicker first look at disaster imagery.
projects.detail: A hackathon prototype for AI hazard summaries, severity estimates and image mapping. Missing GPS uses demo coordinates.

projects.name: TermVision
projects.brief: Video, translated into a terminal's language.
projects.detail: Full-color ASCII playback with resize-aware output and frame skipping. Optional audio playback on Windows.

focus.title: LLM reliability
